notes:
Account background:
- Ironbark builds orchestration layer for enterprise contact centers (omnichannel routing + agent desktop). 1,800 agents across NA/EU, rapidly growing into APAC. Heavy peak periods (promotions) cause 3-4x concurrent volume spikes.

Use-case summary:
- Primary goal: real-time agent assist that streams short, contextual suggestions and next-action buttons into agent desktop with sub-200ms first-suggestion SLO.
- Secondary: ticket summarization on call wrap, tool-calling for CRM updates (create ticket, update status, fetch customer history).
- Needs robust guardrails: hallucination mitigation, exact-match verification for tool-calls, redact PII on-the-fly.

Technical & deployment notes:
- Prefer private deployment (VPC or on-prem) for data residency and latency; evaluating Redwood Dedicated for dedicated GPU pools and failover to private in EU.
- Current stack: Genesys Cloud front-end, Kafka event bus, Postgres OLAP for transcripts. Want streaming hooks (server-sent events / websockets) and token-level cost telemetry.
- Target throughput: 1,200 concurrent live agent sessions normally, up to 4,800 during spikes; expect average turn length 80 tokens, 1-3 suggestion streams per turn.
- Latency targets: 90% <150ms to first suggestion, tail (p99) <350ms. Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to trade some cost for strict SLOs but need optimize recommendations (quant, batching).
- Model preference: open LLMs with quantized weights on dedicated GPU; fallbacks to smaller local variants for degraded mode, and optional hosted model for burst overflow.

Security & compliance:
- SOC2 required; ISO27001 desirable. Must support SSO (SAML), KMS integration for keys, and immutable audit logs for tool-call events. Retention controls for transcripts (30/90/365d).
- Customer security team requested full network diagram + threat model; outstanding questionnaire answers sent 2026-03-04 (see drive doc).

- 2026-02-20: Intro demo with AE/SE; live demo of streaming suggestions (ff_2026-02-20_ironbark_demo). Notes: impressed by fallback policies but asked about token telemetry.

- 2026-03-04: Security review kickoff; provided draft answers and Drive link (security FAQ). Fireflies: ff_2026-03-04_security_review.
